meta.title: Implement simple compile-time folding for pure calls
meta.body_summary: Detect function purity in type checker, mark builtins as pure, and fold pure calls with literal arguments at compile-time for Go, Python and TypeScript backends.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex implemented compile-time folding of pure calls across three backends; merged by maintainer within 1 minute with no review or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 222 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume, concentrated in a new pure analysis module and small compiler tweaks. It fits a self-contained compiler optimization PR that merged without review, indicating low perceived risk by the maintainer.

review_details.concern_detail: No reviewer feedback in dataset; PR was self-merged immediately.
review_details.performance_claim: Fold pure calls with literal arguments at compile-time, reducing runtime overhead in Go, Python, and TypeScript compilation.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Implementing purity detection and constant folding across three language backends requires cross-cutting compiler knowledge; the agent succeeded in a small, well-scoped PR that was merged instantly without review, suggesting either maintainer trust or a straightforward, additive change.

core_change_summary.description: Added purity detection in types/pure.go, marked builtins len and str as pure, added interpreter/consteval.go for constant evaluation of pure calls, and used that in Go/Python/TypeScript compilers to fold calls with literal arguments.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Small changes in compiler backends to invoke the new pure-call evaluation; check.go updated for purity detection.
